tools.name: search_memory
tools.description: Hybrid FTS + vector search over stored memories. Returns ranked hits.

tools.name: recall_memory
tools.description: Top-K semantic recall over stored memories. Alias of search_memory with k default 5.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Directly insert a memory into the store, bypassing the distillation pipeline.

tools.name: get_health
tools.description: Returns daemon health status and version.

tools.name: why_memory
tools.description: Provenance receipt for a memory: evidence excerpt, source session, transcript ref.

tools.name: session_digest
tools.description: What I learned this session: per-type counts + texts of memories formed. Defaults to the latest session.

tools.name: invalidate_memory
tools.description: Mark a memory invalid (soft delete). Appends an invalidate event to the memory_events log.

tools.name: supersede_memory
tools.description: Replace an old memory with a new one: invalidates old_id and links it to new_id via the memory_events log.

tools.name: promote_memory
tools.description: Promote a memory's scope upward — private -> team -> org (ADR-009). Downward/same-scope requests error.

tools.name: restore_memory
tools.description: Un-archive a memory previously archived by the W4.4 TTL policy or a manual archive event.

tools.name: memory_history
tools.description: Full memory_events log for a memory, in append order — the supersession/invalidation/promotion chain.

tools.name: mark_memory_used
tools.description: ADR-010 explicit recall-used signal: tell astramemory a previously-served memory actually mattered in this turn.

tools.name: erase_memory
tools.description: Erasure v1 (ADR-006): permanently hard-delete a memory, leaving only a tombstone event.

tools.name: list_consolidation_proposals
tools.description: Pending (or resolved) consolidation proposals from the stage-9 pass (ADR-004): borderline near-duplicate pairs awaiting an explicit merge/keep decision.

tools.name: resolve_consolidation_proposal
tools.description: Accept or reject a pending consolidation proposal.
